It may be one line or two lines split after the colon, without changing the text or spaces. Place the inquiry line below in a clear readable size. The reading route is title, rendezvous, practical equipment/preparation, participation/weather conditions, application, inquiry. Balance the text-led invitation with the equipment view; do not make the action image crowd any supplied condition.
